round_1.verdict_verbatim:
VERDICT: APPROVE
REVIEWER: independent executor-lane reviewer (non-author)
REVIEWED_DIFF: git diff HEAD @ 60ce67971de65c1337d09010fd9eaa6ab5fc7073
RATIONALE: Port routing is airtight (main.rs imports no port trait, facades own zero I/O, validate_pass_record guards both adapter write paths, monotonicity proven against the persisted head by spy-counted and reopen tests), spec matches code exactly, and the bin's mutations stay confined to the two bridge stores with an honest retirement-marked header; only sub-major data-quality gaps remain.
FINDINGS:
- [minor] tools/oya-fabric-loop-state-app/src/lib.rs:448 - derive never checks completed_at_epoch_s against review_first_verdict_at_epoch_s, so a card "completed" before its first review verdict is admitted (arithmetically safe, semantically inverted timeline slips the fail-closed net)
- [nit] tools/oya-fabric-loop-state-app/src/main.rs:218 - verify-done space-joins multiple --evidence values into one composite ref while USAGE documents a single REF; lossy and silently accepted
- [nit] tools/oya-fabric-loop-state-app/src/main.rs:56 - now_epoch_s falls back to 0 on clock error, stamping claim/run/pass records with epoch 0 instead of refusing
- [nit] tools/oya-fabric-loop-state-app/src/lib.rs:1706 - pass_seqs silently skips unparseable pass-*.json names, so foreign/corrupt ledger filenames are ignored rather than surfaced

fixes: CardFlowMetrics::derive now rejects completion-before-first-review-verdict (fail-closed InvalidMetrics) + unit regression guard
FsFlowMetricsStore::pass_seqs now fails closed (PlaneError::Corrupt) on foreign/unparseable ledger filenames + planted pass-shadow.json contract regression guard
bin now_epoch_s returns Result and main fails closed on clock error (no epoch-0 stamping)
bin verify-done requires exactly one --evidence REF

round_2.verdict_verbatim:
VERDICT: APPROVE
REVIEWER: independent executor-lane reviewer (non-author, round 2)
REVIEWED_DIFF: git diff HEAD @ 60ce67971de65c1337d09010fd9eaa6ab5fc7073
RATIONALE: All four round-1 findings are genuinely fixed with regression guards (derive rejects completion-before-first-verdict + unit case MPV2-0005; pass_seqs fails closed with PlaneError::Corrupt + planted pass-shadow.json contract guard; now_epoch_s returns Result and main fails closed before dispatch; verify-done slice-pattern requires exactly one --evidence), and the surrounding diff introduces no blocker/major regression.
FINDINGS:
- [nit] tools/oya-fabric-loop-state-app/src/lib.rs:1743 - FsFlowMetricsStore::passes silently drops a seq whose canonical zero-padded file is absent (e.g. planted non-canonical pass-7.json parses into pass_seqs and bumps the monotonic head in record_pass, yet its content is invisible to pass()/passes()); pass_seqs could also require the canonical 20-digit filename to fail such names closed
- [nit] tools/oya-fabric-loop-state-app/src/main.rs:228 - verify-done arity violation is reported as PlaneError::Corrupt, a store-corruption variant, for what is a CLI usage error (same pattern as define-card; a usage-error variant or plain fail() would be more honest)
round_2.disposition_of_round_2_nits: Both harvested as durable backlog cards MPV2-0000.C003 and MPV2-0000.C004 (see learning_harvest), not left in chat and not churned as a third review round on an APPROVE verdict.
